name: Improved Flank (Combat)
body:
You deliver more devastating strikes when flanking an enemy.

Prerequisite: Combat Reflexes

Benefit: Gain a +1 bonus on damage rolls against creatures you flank. This bonus goes up to +2 at character level 4, and increases by 1 for every 4 character levels thereafter.
